title: OCR service fallback attribute access can raise before using ocr_router
reasoning: The expression getattr(session, "ocr_router", session.ocr_service) evaluates session.ocr_service before getattr is called. If a valid session implementation provides ocr_router but not ocr_service, this line raises AttributeError instead of using ocr_router. That makes the apparent router-first fallback contract fragile for test doubles or newer session shapes that only expose the router.
reproduction: Pass a session object with ocr_router set to an enabled OCR service and no ocr_service attribute. The coordinator raises AttributeError at service lookup before it can use ocr_router.
recommendation: Use a lazy fallback lookup, for example getattr(session, "ocr_router", None) or getattr(session, "ocr_service", None), so missing legacy attributes do not prevent use of the preferred OCR router.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included, and a fake session with only ocr_router would catch this Python evaluation-order issue.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a coordinator test using a minimal session double that exposes ocr_router but intentionally omits ocr_service, then assert fallback OCR succeeds.
minimumFixScope: Change only the OCR service lookup expression and add a small session-shape regression test.
